skill.name: youtube-api-skill
skill.description: Extract YouTube video and channel metrics from keyword searches using BrowserAct's hosted workflow and a local Python helper.
skill.summary: Run BrowserAct workflows to collect YouTube video metrics for research and monitoring.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs the advertised BrowserAct workflow through outbound API calls, environment-based credential access, and a documented local Python command. Most Markdown backtick and reconnaissance findings are false positives, but the skill does instruct users to provide an API key directly and advertises automation bypass benefits. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The instructions ask users to provide the BrowserAct API key directly when it is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Remove direct key collection language and require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or a managed secret store only.

remediation.issue: The skill sends authenticated requests and search terms to api.browseract.com.
remediation.suggestion: Document the external requests, the data sent, and any BrowserAct retention policy before users run the workflow.

remediation.issue: The feature list presents CAPTCHA and geofencing avoidance as benefits.
remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass-oriented claims and add guidance to follow YouTube terms, robots rules, and regional access limits.

remediation.issue: The skill asks agents to run a local Python script with user-provided arguments.
remediation.suggestion: State that arguments must be passed as separate argv values and must not be interpolated into shell commands.

semantic_findings.title: Insecure API Key Collection Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to request the BrowserAct API key from the user and the script says to provide it to the agent. This can place secrets in chat logs instead of managed storage.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly guide the user toward providing an API key when the environment variable is missing. The safer pattern is to require environment or secret-manager setup only.

semantic_findings.title: Automation Bypass Claims
semantic_findings.description: The documentation advertises no CAPTCHA issues and no IP restrictions or geofencing as benefits. These claims can encourage automated collection that bypasses platform protections or access rules.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The claims are explicit in the feature list, but the files do not show stealth code inside this package. The risk is the stated use context and recommended workflow.

content.value_statement: YouTube research often requires repeated collection of video and channel metrics. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns structured results for keyword and date filters.
actual_capabilities: Runs a bundled Python helper for YouTube keyword searches.
Accepts search keywords and upload date filters.
Starts and polls a BrowserAct workflow until completion.
Returns video titles, URLs, channel names, views, likes, comments, and durations.
Reports task status while the BrowserAct workflow is running.
Handles missing or invalid BrowserAct API key errors.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key before use.
Sends search terms and workflow requests to BrowserAct.
Results depend on YouTube page availability and BrowserAct workflow behavior.
Long running tasks can take several minutes or time out.

use_cases.title: Track Campaign Videos
use_cases.description: Collect recent video metrics for branded keywords and compare views, likes, and comments.

use_cases.title: Research Topic Trends
use_cases.description: Build a current list of videos for a market topic and identify high engagement results.

use_cases.title: Monitor Competitor Channels
use_cases.description: Find competitor videos for selected topics and review channel, duration, and engagement data.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Topic Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube videos about AI agent tutorials from this week and summarize the key metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Campaign Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Search YouTube for our campaign keyword from this month. Return the strongest videos by views, likes, and comments.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Content Themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate searches for browser automation and web agents from this week. Compare engagement patterns and list notable channels.

prompt_templates.title: Build Weekly Monitoring Report
prompt_templates.prompt: For these three topics, collect this week's YouTube metrics, compare top videos, and highlight changes worth tracking next week.

output_examples.input: Search for browser automation videos from this week.
output: A ranked list of matching videos with channel names, upload dates, views, duration, likes, and comments.
A short summary of the strongest videos and the most active channels.

output_examples.input: Monitor recent videos for a competitor product keyword.
output: A comparison of recent videos that mention the keyword, grouped by channel.
Notes on high engagement videos and links for manual review.

output_examples.input: Collect this month's videos for a research topic.
output_examples.output: A concise research brief with video links, channel details, engagement metrics, and outliers to inspect.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or managed secrets before running the skill.
Use narrow keywords and date filters to reduce noisy results.
Review returned video links before using metrics in reports or dashboards.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat transcripts or shared documents.
Do not assume returned metrics are complete for all YouTube results.
Do not use broad keywords when the workflow needs precise monitoring data.

faq.question: Does this skill require a BrowserAct account?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a valid BrowserAct API key configured as BROWSERACT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What YouTube data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return video titles, URLs, channel names, publish dates, views, likes, comments, subscribers, and durations.

faq.question: Does it store my API key?
faq.answer: The script reads the key from the environment and does not store it in files.

faq.question: Can it guarantee every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on YouTube search behavior and the BrowserAct workflow output.

faq.question: How long does a run take?
faq.answer: Runs can take several minutes because the BrowserAct workflow performs browser automation before returning results.
